chat.copy_hover: Click to copy the original value
chat.note.restore: Reopen the world in singleplayer, or restart the dedicated server.
command.invalid_task_time: Provide an ISO-8601 task time, or use fromid with a task ID.
command.task_time_ambiguous: Multiple tasks share that time. Select one with fromid.
command.tasks_empty: No recent tasks in this session.
command.task_unavailable: Task unavailable: it may have finished and been evicted (records are kept briefly), or the ID is wrong. Use /barusikozako task to list current tasks.
command.service_unavailable: Backup services are unavailable. See server log.
command.invalid_snapshot_time: Provide an ISO-8601 snapshot time, for example 1970-01-01T00:00:00.000000000Z.
command.snapshot_time_not_found: No committed snapshot has that time. Use /barusikozako list to check available times.
command.invalid_snapshot_folder: Provide the full snapshot folder name, with a UTC timestamp and UUID separated by --.
command.snapshot_folder_not_found: No committed snapshot matches that folder name.
command.snapshot_time_ambiguous: Multiple committed snapshots share that time. Select one by UUID instead.
command.snapshot_not_found: No committed snapshot has that UUID.
command.snapshots_empty: No committed snapshots on this page.
command.query_failed: Snapshot query failed. See server log.
command.config_saved: Configuration saved. Restart the server to apply it.
notice.relaxed_restore: This snapshot was captured with relaxed consistency; files may come from slightly different moments.
command.config_rejected: Configuration change rejected. See server log.
command.ignore_rules_more: See the server log for all rules.
command.task_delivery_failed: Unable to deliver task results for %s.
rejection.unavailable: the service is not ready or is shutting down; try again shortly
rejection.not_authorized: you do not have permission for this operation; ask an administrator to grant it
rejection.busy: another backup or repository maintenance is running; wait for it to finish and retry
rejection.unsupported: the active backend or environment does not support this operation
rejection.invalid_request: the request is invalid: check the UUID, time or backup mode
cancel.not_available: Cancellation: no matching task — it may have finished, been evicted, or the ID is wrong
result.verified_snapshot: Full verification passed for %s (%d entries, %d bytes).
result.backup_relaxed: Backup committed %s (%d files differ in time).
result.restore_queued: Restore queued for %s. Singleplayer restore runs when you reopen this world. On a dedicated server, restart the server.
result.failed: Backup operation failed (%s). Resolve the cause above and try again.
result.uncertain: Commit outcome is uncertain: the snapshot may or may not have been written. Run list to inspect the repository before retrying.
failure.lost_authorization: Your permission was revoked. Confirm the operator still has backup permission, or ask an administrator to grant it again.
failure.source_unavailable: The world could not be read: online capture may be disabled, the world folder may be in use, or the world has not finished loading. Confirm backup services are ready and try again once the world is loaded.
failure.integrity: Integrity check failed: snapshot data does not match its checksums, possibly due to disk corruption or an interrupted write. Run verify, and delete and recreate the snapshot if needed.
failure.resource_limit: A configured limit was exceeded: file count, a single file, or total content is too large. Check whether the world grew unexpectedly, or ask an administrator to raise the read limits.
failure.io: The backup folder could not be read or written. Common causes are low disk space, missing folder permission, a disconnected disk, or antivirus locking the backup files. Check free space and permissions, then retry.
failure.snapshot_is_baseline: This snapshot is still the baseline of a differential backup; deleting it would break the dependent backups. Delete the newer dependent snapshots first, then delete this one.
failure.internal: Internal error: the backup program reached an unexpected state and the snapshot was usually not written. Restart the server and retry; if it persists, share the matching server log entry with the developer.
failure.native_access_denied: Java blocked Windows native access. On Java 25, remove --illegal-native-access=deny from the JVM arguments and restart. If the server requires deny mode, ask the administrator to authorize native access.
failure.directory_sync_failed: Windows directory flush failed. Check that the backup and world directories are on local NTFS and that the server account can write and flush them. Check the server log for the Windows error.
notice.startup_schedule: Periodic backups are disabled by default. Set schedule.intervalSeconds in server.yml to enable automatic backups.
notice.scheduled_failed: Periodic backup failed. See the server log for details.
notice.scheduled_rejected: Periodic backup did not start. See the server log for details.
command.config_read_failed: Could not read configuration. See server log.
help.status: /barusikozako status — show service, repository and schedule status
help.version: /barusikozako version — show mod, API and backend versions
help.backup: /barusikozako backup [note "text"] — start a backup now, optionally with a note (visible in snapshot details only)
help.list: /barusikozako list [page <n>] — 4 snapshots per page; click a UUID/time to copy, or a button to fill an action
help.list_version: /barusikozako list version <backends|mod|extensions> — show backend, mod or extension versions
help.detail: /barusikozako detail <snapshot> — show time, operator, versions and statistics
help.task: /barusikozako task [page <n>] — 4 tasks per page; click a button to inspect or cancel
help.backend: Backend modes: /<alias> backup <mode> (for example differential, fixed-chunks)
help.footer: Snapshot arguments accept a UUID prefix, an ISO time, or fullname <folder>.
